 04/Dated: 31/08/2016
 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the Stat
The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with the case  registered under Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standard Act.
Pursuant to the order dated 26.08.2016 record of Cr.M.P No. 1264 of 2016  was called for the same has been received.
It appears that Cr.M.P No. 1264 of 2016 has been filed by the petitioner   07.06.2016 for quashing the order taking cognizance under Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standard Act.

From perusal of the record that learned A.C.J.M., has taken cognizance under Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standard Act.
59- Any person who whether by himself or by any other person on his behalf, manufactures for sale or stores or sells or distributes or imports any article of food for human consumption which is unsafe, shall be punishable:
(i) Where such failure or contravention does not result in injury, with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months and also with fine which may extend to one lakh rupees;
(ii) Where such failure or contravention result in a non-grievous injury with imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year and also with fine which may extend to three lakh rupees.

(iii) Where such failure or contravention results in a grievous injury with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six years and also with fine which may Pappu Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand on 31 August, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143243287/
1 extend to five lakhs rupees.

sentences.text: (iv) where such failure or contravention results in death, with imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than seven years but which may extend to imprisonment for life and also with fine which shall not be less than ten lakh rupees.

In the fact and circumstances of the case, the above named petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within three weeks from the date of this order and in the event of his arrest or surrender the Court below shall enlarge the above named petitioner on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi in connection with Case No. C-III 197 of 2013,
subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
Let the Cr.M.P No. 1264 of 2016 be sent to the concerned Section.

(Anant Bijay Singh, J.) Satayendra/
